notes: Usually refers to a person's leg (or animal meat); for the leg of a live four-legged animal or a piece of furniture, use 'la pata'.

senses.definition: The lower limb of the human body, from the hip to the ankle.

draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and grounded, referring to a part of the self
notes: In Spanish, 'pierna' refers specifically to the whole leg, including the thigh and lower leg. It is distinct from 'el pie' (the foot).
Do not confuse this with 'el pie', which only refers to the foot itself.
